pedals.axis.rudder.name: Rudder
pedals.axis.rudder.note: rudder pivot with the motor-driven sector gear between the pedals

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), MFG Crosswind pedals with the Kaltokri RhinoMFG kit, seen from the front and above: the VPforce motor plate and sector gear in the middle between the two pedals
mappingSource: catalog (vpforce.json, confidence medium): the VPforce board drives the rudder only, X axis (docs tell to disable Y; https://docs.vpforce.eu/third-party-vendors/kaltokri-kits/ and https://docs.vpforce.eu/third-party-vendors/kaltokri-kits/rhinomfg/)
note: The model covers six conversions (RhinoMFG / MFG86 / TPR / ACE / Orion / R1); this photo shows the MFG Crosswind build. The toe brakes stay on the pedals' own USB device and have no part here.
